Team —

I ran the pre-run checks on our side and attached the runbook + a quick checklist. Key notes for the commissioning run tomorrow:

Preconditions (done):
- 24-GPU pool provisioned in us-west-2 (8x additional A100-equivalent instances)
- QoS profile set to "reserved-heavy" for the dedicated pool
- Canary model variant deployed (v2.3-quant) to test fallback path

Load profile we will simulate:
- 2 hour soak, 30m ramp, steady-state 220 reqs/min, 1.2k average tokens
- 20% of requests will include stateful chat history (KV loads)
- 10% will trigger function/tool calls to simulate real-world tails

Acceptance criteria (hard):
- 95th percentile latency across all regions < 1800ms
- Error rate < 0.5% (5xx & timeouts)
- No degradation of cold-starts beyond 20% of baseline for new connections

Monitoring and post-run checks: 
- Grafana dashboards: "AtlasHealth / Dedicated / Throughput", "Latency by Model Variant"
- Alerting: 95th latency > 2s -> P2; Error rate > 1% -> P1
- We'll provide: load CSV, per-minute token/sec, tail latency percentiles, and a short remediation list if thresholds miss

Attachments:
- redwood_dedicated_runbook_capacity-runbook.pdf (checklist + commands)
I've included the load test script and a small warmup helper for your infra team to run locally if desired.

- Marissa
Senior Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

Marissa/Ben —

We kicked off the commissioning run per the runbook this morning. Attached is the raw CSV (20261110-load-test-summary.csv) and a short nurse-note: overall the pool met the steady-state target of 220 reqs/min for 95 of the 120 minutes; the final 25 minutes saw a spike in function-call latency that pushed the 95th to ~1980ms in us-west-2. Error rate remained at 0.35% overall.

Observed details: 
- KV prefill hit: ~92% hit rate on warmed prefixes during steady-state
- Tail latency increase correlated with multi-step function calls at 75–85 concurrent sessions
- Fallback path executed cleanly twice when a node was reaped during the run

Immediate recommendations:
1) Increase the function-call offload batch size by +20% to smooth kernel scheduling for tooling tails
2) Add a short retry (200ms jitter) for the function call executor to reduce transient 5xx
3) We'll re-run a 60m targeted test on Fri to validate the tweak if you want

Link to raw CSV and Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/atlashealth/dedicated-capacity-overview
Regards,
Team CloudOps Lab
